get.description: Liveness: the process is serving requests.

Readiness: the database answers. Without a real LLM ARIA still works (deterministic).

It needs no key, for the platform's probes. When the API requires keys, a caller without
one learns only whether ARIA is ready, not its providers or what its memory holds.
LLM providers, their models and circuit-breaker state. Never includes secrets.

post.description:
Check a visitor's own key before it is used, and keep nothing.

The provider lists its models for the key, which costs nothing. Where that list answers
anyone (NVIDIA's), one tiny request checks the key instead.

get.description: Returns the public AgentCard describing this agent's capabilities, supported transports, and skills.

post.description:
A2A JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint. The `method` field selects the operation;
`params` must match that method's schema (see the `oneOf` below).

**Supported methods:**

- `SendMessage` — Send a message to the agent (returns a Task or response Message).
- `SendStreamingMessage` — Send a message and receive a Server-Sent Events stream.
- `GetTask` — Fetch a task by ID.
- `ListTasks` — List tasks with pagination and filtering.
- `CancelTask` — Cancel an in-progress task.
- `CreateTaskPushNotificationConfig` — Register a push-notification config on a task.
- `GetTaskPushNotificationConfig` — Read a single push-notification config.
- `ListTaskPushNotificationConfigs` — List all push-notification configs for a task.
- `DeleteTaskPushNotificationConfig` — Delete a push-notification config.
- `SubscribeToTask` — Subscribe to task events via Server-Sent Events.
- `GetExtendedAgentCard` — Fetch the authenticated extended agent card.

AlertSignal.title: AlertSignal
AlertSignal.description: An alert from a monitoring system, normalised across Alertmanager, Grafana and webhooks.

CalibrationOut.title: CalibrationOut
CalibrationOut.description: Where the severity model's calibration stands against the reviews gathered so far.

Claim.title: Claim
Claim.description: One statement in a report, tied to the evidence that supports it.

Delivery.title: Delivery
Delivery.description: A message a reviewer approved, and what happened when ARIA sent it.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: A citable fact produced by a tool or a deterministic computation.

ExpertCheckOut.title: ExpertCheckOut
ExpertCheckOut.description: A replayed run's flagged units of work, next to the labels the system's experts gave.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: Who is calling. With no API keys configured the API is open and nobody signs in.

ModelKeyCheck.title: ModelKeyCheck
ModelKeyCheck.description: What a provider said about a visitor's own key. The key itself is not kept.

RealIncidentOut.title: RealIncidentOut
RealIncidentOut.description: A stretch of a real system's log, with its experts' labels, ready to replay.

ReportEdits.title: ReportEdits
ReportEdits.description:
A reviewer's changes, bounded like the report they change. A bad edit is refused with 422
when it is sent, instead of failing the run (a summary line too long for a claim) or
publishing a blank claim or action when it is applied.

ReviewOut.title: ReviewOut
ReviewOut.description: One human review, as the active-learning queue keeps it.

ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest
ReviewRequest.description: A reviewer's decision. With API keys, the reviewer is the authenticated key's name.

SettingsOut.title: SettingsOut
SettingsOut.description: The configuration a reviewer may see: limits, guardrails and routing, never secrets.

Severity.title: Severity
Severity.description: Incident severity. SEV1 is the most severe.

TicketAssessment.title: TicketAssessment
TicketAssessment.description: Priority and SLA-breach risk for an ITSM ticket, from the model trained on UCI history.

TicketContext.title: TicketContext
TicketContext.description: ITSM ticket fields as they exist when a ticket is opened (ServiceNow-style).

TicketHistoryStats.title: TicketHistoryStats
TicketHistoryStats.description: Outcomes of historically similar ITSM tickets (UCI ServiceNow event log).

TriageRequest.title: TriageRequest
TriageRequest.description: Input to a triage run. At least one of logs, window_id, alerts or ticket is required.
